description: Installation of an internal illuminated sequential advertisement capable of static and dynamic content display with automatic rotation of images.
decision_conditions: <p dir="ltr" style="line-height:1.2;margin-top:6pt;margin-bottom:6pt;"><span style="font-size:10pt;font-family:Arial,sans-serif;color:#000000;background-color:transparent;font-weight:400;font-style:normal;font-variant:normal;text-decoration:none;vertical-align:baseline;white-space:pre;white-space:pre-wrap;">The proposed location would be in close proximity to a school, traffic signs and a taxi rank and it is therefore considered that the location of&nbsp; the animated sign would be contrary to guidance commissioned by TFL with regards to public safety. No detailed site specific analysis of the sites suitability for animated advertisement has been provided to the council in line with TFL’s guidance and therefore the council cannot be assured that the proposal would have an acceptable impact on Highway safety.</span></p><p><span id="docs-internal-guid-b7a68b9c-7fff-7ea7-5b3e-b0e3b4cde1b9"></span></p><p dir="ltr" style="line-height:1.38;margin-top:0pt;margin-bottom:0pt;"><span style="font-size:10pt;font-family:Arial,sans-serif;color:#000000;background-color:#ffffff;font-weight:400;font-style:normal;font-variant:normal;text-decoration:none;vertical-align:baseline;white-space:pre;white-space:pre-wrap;">There is considered to be insufficient evidence proving that the proposed animated display is appropriate for this location and the proposal is therefore deemed to fail to comply with the relevant policies, including those of the Town and Country Planning (Control of Advertisements) (England) Regulations 2007, which require advertisements to be assessed based on their impact on amenity and public safety.</span></p>

<p><span id="docs-internal-guid-0ee98810-7fff-f650-fd40-2a0def6a1ffe"></span></p><p dir="ltr" style="line-height:1.38;margin-top:0pt;margin-bottom:0pt;"><span style="font-size:10pt;font-family:Arial,sans-serif;color:#000000;background-color:transparent;font-weight:400;font-style:normal;font-variant:normal;text-decoration:none;vertical-align:baseline;white-space:pre;white-space:pre-wrap;">The proposal would be harmful to the local character of the area, would adversely affect the historic significance of the nearby listed heritage assets, would detract from the amenity of the street scene and would cause visual intrusion from moving images. The proposal is therefore not considered to be compliant with Policy LP1, LP3&nbsp; LP7 of LP33, The London Plan Policy HC1 Heritage conservation and growth Part C:, the Commercial Extensions and Alterations SPD (2025), Stamford Hill Area Action Plan publication&nbsp; (SHAAP) (2024.) and the Institute of Lighting Professionals (ILP) publication: “The Brightness of Illuminated Advertisements” (PLG05, January 2015).</span></p>
